translation: Understood. I'll do my best to lead Suzumiya.
Thanks, I really appreciate it.

For the time being, our goal has been set.
Though I'm still concerned about this situation.

We haven't encountered any major problems
yet, but you never know…

Nagato, have you figured out the location of
the data lifeform or whatever it's called?
Not yet.

More time is required to pinpoint its
coordinates.

What kind of data lifeform could this be that
even Miss Nagato's methods can't pinpoint it?

You sound like you doubt its existence even
though Nagato just confirmed it.

Could it have already gone back to its own
world…?

That is improbable. Traces of the subject are
constantly being identified.
It's probably just really good at hiding.
As usual, the situation is less than ideal.

And we can't say that Miss Suzumiya's mental
state is looking good either.
I was just contacted by my associates.

By the suspicious organization Koizumi
operates under—the "Agency,” right?

It's not quite severe enough that closed
space is sprouting up yet, but…
It's only a matter of time.
It seems like things are only getting worse.

We have no choice but to make a continuous
effort to keep Miss Suzumiya occupied.

As per the aforementioned plan, we'll also
have to grab her attention with other things…
Yeah, I guess…

It's all a huge pain, but with the world at
stake, what other option do we have?

When I phrase it like that, it makes us sound
like heroes saving the planet.

So why don't I feel heroic in the absolute
least? Huh, Haruhi?
Good grief…

Then, in accordance with our "guide by the
hand” strategy, we'll lead Miss Suzumiya.
Because we have no other choice.

If we did, it'd be along the lines of dragging
her out of the building by force.

Of course there would still be the fear of
worsening Haruhi's mood. Ahhh, what a pain.

Shouldn't be long before those two are
finished. Let's just go meet up with them.

I can hear it already… "Waiting outside of the
girls' bathroom? You're the worst!”
It's okay, I'm sure everything will work out.

Asahina admirably went out of her way to
encourage me with her smile.

Well then, it's about time we head off, don't
you think?

You guys go on ahead—I'm gonna clean the
wall that Haruhi stained with her shoes.
Do you mind if I stay and help you, Kyon?
No no, there's absolutely no need.

Just the sentiment alone was enough. Thanks
for healing my heart, Asahina.
I will go ahead.

Nagato walked off, followed by Koizumi and
Asahina.
Well then, I'd better get rid of these marks…

Not that I'm her guardian or personal janitor
or anything like that.
Umm, where's something to wipe with…?
Hm…?

I guess that was the strange sensation you
might refer to as "feeling a presence.”
…Excuse me?

What I saw when I looked over my shoulder—
it was certainly unexpected—

But at the same time… I felt like I knew this
was coming.
Wha—?!
Standing there was…

The long-haired girl I saw walking past the
window before.

Wait wait wait, is it actually? Couldn't it just
be a look-alike?

Please tell me I'm wrong, but isn't she an
actual spirit?

The possibility isn't zero. If Haruhi really
wanted it, even ghosts could surely turn up.
Wh… Who are you?

Those words I had barely managed to get out
were swallowed up by the ensuing silence.
What is this feeling…?

It's like all the hairs on my body are standing
on end.

The air feels unduly cold, even though it's the
middle of summer.
Huh…?

In that moment, the girl who hadn't moved a
muscle suddenly beckoned to me with her hand.

That movement like branches swaying in the
wind—for a mere moment, I was captivated—
Uh?!
It was an unbelievable sight.
Hey, you're kidding, right…?
This isn't… that alternate space, is it?!

That 1-10 classroom that Nagato rescued me
from earlier…
Seriously? It's happening again…?

I instinctively scanned around and it was just
as I expected—no doors in sight.

Only these featureless walls, conjured to
separate me from the outside world.

As if they'd always been there, since long
ago…
Calm down, calm down—just cool your head.
What might've caused me to end up here?

Was it that long-haired girl that sent me
here? What is she exactly?
Some spirit that Haruhi created?
Or maybe some kind of data lifeform?

Not that it matters, but getting trapped in
suspicious classrooms like this repeatedly…

Bitter memories of when Ryoko Asakura tried
to kill me float back to the surface.

I don't think so but, could someone be aiming
to kill me this time as well?
If they are… I can't afford to waste any time.
…Huh?

At that moment, something entered my field of
vision.
A laptop…?

In the center of the classroom, a singular
laptop had been left running.

There was one the last time I came here, too.
Could this be the data lifeform's main body?
Wah…?!

This could be dangerous… Wait no, it's
definitely dangerous.
Let's assume that this really is class 1-10.
What was it that Haruhi kept calling it again?

She gave it some considerably ominous
nickname, I'm sure of it.
Ah… the "man-eating classroom.”

In other words—if I don't do something about
this, am I going to be eaten alive?
This is bad—this is seriously bad.

What did she have in mind when she thought
up this "man-eating classroom” anyways?

Honestly, it's far too sinister—I don't even
want to know.
Hey! Is there anyone outside?!
Nagato! Koizumi! Asahina!

I went back and forth across the wall, hitting
it in search of an exit, but to no avail.
—Until finally…
Whoa whoa whoa whoa whoa?!

A giant mouth emerged onto the classroom's
blackboard, baring countless fangs…
You've gotta be kidding, Haruhi!!
What should I do? What even can I do?!

How did I get out of this last time? Try to
remember. Come on brain, try to remember—
—! The mop!

I just need to wipe away that horrific, giant
mouth with a mop!

I ran to the locker housing the cleaning
equipment and took out a mop.

Just like before, carefully bring the head of
the mop closer to the blackboard—
Wha?!

The mop was easily snatched up by the fangs
and snapped like a twig…!

And as if it couldn't get any worse, that big
mouth is only getting bigger.

While I'm at it, looks like it's inching closer and
closer to me as well—
Damn, what do I do? What do I do?!
This laptop is clearly suspicious.

But even so, there's no way of knowing what
I'm supposed to do with it.
Maybe I should just destroy it?

Or maybe I could enter some kind of
password…

Don't tell me you're here just so I can write my
last will and testament?

With my back pressed against the wall—I
scowled at the blackboard's impending mouth.

The mop was useless, there's no exit, and as
a bonus, I'm about to be devoured alive.
What the hell should I—
Move.
A voice came from behind me.
N-Nagato? Is that you, Nagato?!

A crack ran across the wall, splitting it wide
open with the sound of shattering glass.
What emerged from the crack was…
We made it in time.
Looks like you're completely unscathed.
Nagato! And Koizumi too…!

This is another perilous situation indeed. I see
—it certainly is a "man-eating” classroom.

Now's not the time to chat. If the three of us
don't get out of here fast, we're all done for!
Impossible.
Huh…?

Behind Nagato, the broken wall was
reconstructed with an almighty force.
Wh-what in the world…?!

There was a great likelihood that we wouldn't
have time to deal with it from the outside.
Wouldn't have time…?

The data lifeform is trying to increase its
existence probability in this space.

In other words, our lives are in danger as
long as we're in here?
Yes.

So what are you guys planning to do about it
now that you're in here with me?
Use this…

Saying so, Nagato once again handed me a
mop.

I just tried that, but it was completely
useless.

Without appended attribute data it's only a
mop.

So you're telling me this is more than just a
mop now?

Yes. Use this to destroy the singularities
keeping this space stabilized.

You want me to play clean up again? At such
a critical moment?
Yes.

You can see that blackboard too, right
Nagato?
I can see it. It is not a major obstacle.

With her usual nonchalance, Nagato held out
her hand in front of the blackboard.

In that moment, the blackboard snapped
back to its original form with tremendous force.
I will restrain it, so do it now.

Right, I got it! If I just get this done,
everything will be fine!

If worse comes to worst, I'll become a real
spirit and haunt you at night, Haruhi!
About Haruhi
